desc: 青绿软垫加米色布篮的居家场，小三角旗编号条，十屏漏斗式奶瓶详情
leaf: 矮胖宽身圆顶透明罩盖宽口径奶瓶
name: 青绿软垫布篮圆顶罩盖奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用嫩草绿软垫加米色布篮的居家一角一次交代矮胖宽身瓶体、圆顶透明罩盖与宽瓶盖环，抢到首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放一条中文主标（前缀一枚实心小三角旗）与一行深草绿副标，副标下一条带序号码的空白发丝线索引导条

shots.intent: 把源图六枚重复图标与恐吓式疑问句改造成三块软垫留白板，条目全交给占位符，不复述材质与健康断言
shots.textZone: 顶部一条中文小标题前缀一枚实心三角旗加一行深草绿副标，其下一条带序号码的发丝线索引导条，三块留白板各一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图杜撰的 40% 与 100% 电量条对照改成同一垫面划出的两区留白，右区立本品左区整块空给卖家自贴，杜绝虚构对比与百分比
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照小标题前缀三角旗与一行深草绿副标，两区各一条空白标签位，序号码挂在发丝线索引导条上

shots.intent: 仰视微距交代圆顶罩盖、宽瓶盖环与坐在瓶口内的奶嘴的装配关系，三枚三角旗引线撑起做工信任而不写任何结构功效
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签线，左右各一枚空白标签线，左下一行深草绿结构小标题，条目文字全占位

shots.intent: 正侧面交代矮胖宽身轮廓与三条参照引线，把源图自相矛盾的三处 10cm 数值全部改成无字尺寸框，只留空白标签
shots.textZone: 左侧一条无字尺寸示意轨，右侧三行空白标签线挂在三角旗引线上，顶部一行造型小标题

shots.intent: 把源图重复六次的母婴正脸对喂实拍改写成软垫与布篮的居家看护角，成人从肩下取景、婴儿仅背影且全程被托抱，让买家代入又不越界
正俯视交代罩盖顶钮、罩盖圆周与瓶盖环的同心装配关系，一枚三角旗引线承接顶部条目，用真接触面证明不悬空
shots.textZone: 右侧一枚空白标签线挂在三角旗引线上，下方一条带序号码的发丝线索引导条

shots.intent: 把源图串品的档案字段（展开尺寸、折叠尺寸、承重）与会员二维码改成六格空白档案加一整块留证位，任何字段名与数值一律留空
shots.textZone: 顶部一条档案小标题前缀三角旗与一行深草绿副标，其下六行空白档案条目（字段名与数值全空），底部一整块空白留证位

shots.intent: 把首屏那三枚色卡兑现为三支同形态瓶子的并列选款屏，色调用参照而非命名且严禁新造第四色，撑起货架感
shots.textZone: 三瓶下方各一行空白选款标签线，顶部一条选款小标题前缀一枚实心三角旗

shots.intent: 以二十五度俯角在软垫与布篮边收口整套青绿视觉，留出一枚空白行动卡与两枚三角旗标签，引导语全交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放结束标题（前缀三角旗）、一行深草绿副标、一枚空白行动卡与两枚空白三角旗标签线，底部一条带序号码的发丝线

style.backgroundSystem: a domestic nursery corner only: the product always stands on matte spring-green #A3CE7C silicone play-mat sheeting with a fine rubbery tooth and a stitched seam into a cream #EFF3E2 low-pile mat tile, and one cream-and-charcoal woven fabric storage basket #E2E8D3 with a soft rolled rim sits behind at camera right with its weave reading as real textile; depth comes from the mat seam line and the basket edge only; never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never stacked steps or block tiers, never a podium disc, never a tangent sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a glass-and-water studio, never an oak or plank wood surface, never a dark or metallic field
style.direction: fresh spring-green domestic maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce
style.iconSystem: small solid triangular pennant flags in meadow green #4E8A52 hung on one numbered hairline index bar, the bar being a single thin warm-charcoal #3D3B33 rule carrying small light sans ordinal digits, one flag size and one line weight across the whole set; callouts drawn as one hairline leader ending in a small solid triangle resting directly on the referenced part; never a rounded-square squircle chip, never a solid filled circular stamp, never a thin circular medallion, never a dotted circle or dot ring, never a three-dot pagination marker, never a pill or capsule badge, never a bare oversized serif numeral, never a medal, rosette, star or shield
style.lightingSystem: soft fresh neutral daylight at about 5000K entering from behind and to the camera left of the product, so the left edge of the clear dome carries one clean rim while an oversized cream #EFF3E2 bounce card at camera right lifts the whole front; shadows fall short and forward to camera right, one true soft contact shadow grounds the base, contrast stays medium-low, the frosted body shows an even gradient instead of a hot streak, and no other light direction is used anywhere in the set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh spring-green domestic maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte spring-green mat field #A3CE7C, cream ground #EFF3E2 and basket cream #E2E8D3 as bases with one deep meadow-green accent #4E8A52 and warm charcoal text #3D3B33; neutral fresh daylight tone at about 5000K throughout; background system limited to a domestic nursery corner of matte spring-green silicone play-mat sheeting with a fine rubbery tooth and a stitched seam into a cream low-pile mat tile, with one cream-and-charcoal woven fabric storage basket with a soft rolled rim sitting behind at camera right, never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never stacked steps or block tiers, never a podium disc, never a tangent sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a glass-and-water studio, never a wood surface and never a dark or metallic field; soft fresh neutral key at about 5000K entering from behind and to the camera left so the left edge of the clear dome carries one clean rim, an oversized cream bounce card at camera right lifting the front, shadows falling short and forward to camera right, one true soft contact shadow under the base, medium-low contrast and no other light direction; one modern neutral Chinese sans family with a single short headline in warm charcoal #3D3B33 preceded by one small solid meadow-green triangular flag, one short deep-meadow-green sub-line beneath it and small light sans ordinal digits riding the hairline index bar, no Latin overprint, no small-caps kicker, no serif, no highlighter band, one short line of copy only; icon system of small solid triangular pennant flags in meadow green #4E8A52 hung on one numbered hairline index bar at one flag size and one line weight, callouts drawn as one hairline leader ending in a small solid triangle resting on the part, never a squircle chip, never a filled circular stamp, never a thin circular medallion, never a dotted circle, never a three-dot pagination marker, never a pill badge, never a bare oversized serif numeral; the squat wide-bodied bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the mat with the tall clear dome fitted, the collar ring screwed closed and the nipple fully seated inside the dome, keeping the short broad silhouette, the dark shoulder band under the ring, the small apex knob, the inner seal ring visible through the frosted body, the collar ring in its exact reference tone with no fourth colourway invented, any graduation marking kept exactly as shot and any label area left as one blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no dark scenes, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no medical or functional-benefit wording anywhere: no anti-colic, no air-intake or valve mechanism claim, no cure, relief, digestion, comfort-feeding or easy-feeding assertion, and no mechanism caption that implies a health result
no breastfeeding-equivalence or parenting-emotion wording such as 「母乳实感」 「贴近真实乳感」 「仿母乳」 「像喝母乳一样」 or any mother-feeling claim
no thermal-retention or preservation claim such as 「恒温」 「锁温度」 「防酸腐」 「保温」, and no hour, cycle or duration figure attached to any performance
no age or stage indication: no 「各阶段」 「分阶段」 「新生儿」 「宝宝专用」 「萌娃」, no month or year range and no suitability statement about a child

no material or safety-grade claim: no glass, borosilicate, PPSU, PES, silicone grade, food-grade, 「食品级」, 「安全无异味」, 「健康」, BPA-free or 「不含任何有害物质」 wording and no surface-performance claim such as 「耐脏」 「圆润光滑」 「不易粘污」
no sterilisation, disinfection or antibacterial standard: no 「防菌」 「杀菌」 「抑菌」, no sterilisation rate, no percentage and no pathogen or organism name of any kind

no certification, award, medal, rosette, shield, test report, authorisation letter, registration or filing number or execution-standard code, and no doctor, hospital, midwife or laboratory endorsement
no origin, import or manufacturer claim: no 「进口」, no country name, no flag artwork, no 「厂家」 「品牌故事」 wording and no founding-year or heritage statement

no invented numbers: no capacity, no dimension in centimetres or millimetres, no pack or piece count, no shelf life, no weight, no load figure, no net-content value, no price, discount, coupon, countdown or delivery time
no brand name, store name, logo, material-site watermark, corner mark, membership block such as 「加入会员」 「全店免费」, QR code or platform badge, and no leftover Latin filler text of any kind

no visible infant face and no bottle at a child mouth: any child appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw, is always held and fully supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulder down, and the bottle is never left unattended

no loose, unsecured, detached, hanging or exploded nipple, collar ring or dome: the nipple stays seated inside the closed dome in every screen, and no microwave, no steam, no hot liquid or water touching skin appears anywhere in the set
no duplicated identical photo tiles: the reference repeats one stock nursing photograph six times, and no screen may repeat an identical photo card, icon glyph or product inset

no drift between screens: no palette change, no mixed fonts, no limewash plaster, no arched niche, no stacked steps or block tiers, no podium disc, no sphere cluster, no gradient card, no glass-and-water studio, no wood surface, no squircle chip, no filled circular stamp, no dotted circle marker, no bare serif numeral, no pill badge, no inconsistent lighting, no recoloured product and no new colourway
style.presentationRules: the squat wide-bodied bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the matte spring-green mat with the tall clear dome fitted, the wide collar ring screwed closed and the nipple fully seated inside the dome; the short broad silhouette from shoulder to rounded base, the base radius, the dome height, the dark shoulder band directly under the collar ring, the small apex knob on top of the dome and the inner seal ring visible through the frosted body are never redrawn; the collar ring keeps its exact reference tone and the three tone chips shown in the reference are the only tones allowed so no fourth colourway is invented; any graduation marking on the body stays exactly as shot and is never added, removed or resized; the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; the product never floats without its contact shadow, never is occluded by props, one real object anchors scale in every scene shot and vertical lines stay vertical
style.surfaceSystem: matte silicone play-mat sheeting with a fine rubbery tooth and a stitched seam into a cream low-pile mat tile, a shallow rubbery sheen rather than a mirror reflection, the bottle settling with real weight and soft fabric shading where it meets the mat, one pressed-in seam line running behind the base, no gloss floor and no product reflection
style.typography: one modern neutral Chinese sans family throughout; a single short headline in warm charcoal #3D3B33 preceded by one small solid meadow-green #4E8A52 triangular flag, one short sub-line in deep meadow green #4E8A52 beneath it, and small light sans ordinal digits riding the hairline index bar; one short line of copy only, no dense body text; no Latin overprint words, no small-caps Latin kicker lines, no serif, no handwritten or cartoon lettering, no highlighter band behind a keyword, no mixed fonts
